product_launches.description: Boulevard launched ePrescribe, a secure electronic prescribing feature integrated into its medspa business management platform, enabling clinicians to manage prescriptions within patient profiles alongside scheduling, charting, and payments.

overview_description.description: Boulevard provides a client experience platform designed for appointment-based, self-care businesses such as salons, medspas, and barbershops. Its features include precision scheduling for optimizing calendars and client self-booking, an all-in-one point-of-sale system, and built-in marketing and loyalty programs. The platform aims to streamline operations and enhance client retention for beauty and wellness brands.

about_short_description.short_description: Boulevard provides beauty and wellness businesses with tools for booking, payments, marketing, and client relationship management.

product.name: Boulevard Client Experience Platform
product.description: A cloud-based business management platform for appointment-based beauty and wellness businesses, combining booking, client management, payments, marketing, memberships, reporting, and operational tools.

product.name: Precision Scheduling
product.description: Appointment scheduling and online self-booking software that lets clients book services while helping businesses optimize calendars, staff availability, and appointment utilization.

identifier.value: Boulevard Payments and Point of Sale

product.name: Boulevard Payments and Point of Sale
product.description: An integrated payments and point-of-sale system for beauty and wellness businesses, supporting checkout, payment processing, deposits, dispute handling, and retail transactions.

product.name: Client Management and CRM
product.description: Client relationship management tools for maintaining profiles, appointment history, communications, documentation, and other information used to personalize service and manage relationships.

identifier.value: Boulevard Marketing, Messages, Loyalty, and Memberships

product.name: Boulevard Marketing, Messages, Loyalty, and Memberships
product.description: Customer engagement tools for email and text marketing, automated campaigns, two-way messaging, loyalty programs, memberships, and packages.

product.name: Boulevard Forms and Charts
product.description: Digital documentation tools for collecting client or patient forms, storing photos and records, and tracking incomplete documentation within business workflows.
